# git-pm commit built by the `downstream-git-pm` CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
#
# The job checks out gastro and git-pm side by side and runs git-pm's
# `mise run verify` against this gastro checkout. If the pinned git-pm commit
# has `replace github.com/andrioid/gastro => ../gastro` in go.mod, that replace
# resolves to the checkout; otherwise the job writes a go.work joining git-pm,
# gastro and (when present) gastro/datastar.
#
# Bump by hand when git-pm adopts a new gastro release: replace the SHA below
# with the git-pm commit that pins it (`git -C ../git-pm rev-parse HEAD`).
# The first non-comment, non-empty line is the SHA.
# Currently: git-pm branch p12 (phase 12 web rewrite on the v0.4 APIs). Bump
# to the git-pm main commit once p12 is merged there.
dc270d101694d61ca1ae9db54bc4b45be81641a0
